items.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: That’s “First Flight Out,” Tom Harrell and Peter Washington, Victor Lewis on drums, Michael Weiss on piano and myself

ctx.x: That’s “First Flight Out,” Tom Harrell and Peter Washington, Victor Lewis on drums, Michael Weiss on piano and myself, and did I say Tom Harrell?
Right. Could I ask you about how you start a tune, and how it finds its way to completion with a tune like that?
